# Reference Comparison Prompt

Follow injected repository instructions plus `docs/development/REFERENCE_POLICY.md` and `docs/reference-index.md`.

Define one exact behavior, search VictusX first, then inspect 1-5 matching reference files unless expansion is justified. Record repository and commit, summarize in original words, distinguish evidence from exact-device validation, and state licensing concerns before recommending reuse. Do not copy code or modify files without separate authorization.
